articles.summary: Rivian reported a year-over-year increase in vehicle deliveries of 46% during the third quarter.

articles.title: Accenture stock rallies after earnings beat expectations
articles.summary: Shares of Accenture surged Thursday after the company's fiscal fourth-quarter results beat estimates.

articles.title: Nike shares drop as retailer posts disappointing sales, announces layoffs as part of restructuring
articles.summary: Nike is expected to post another quarter of declining sales as the company tries to turn around its business and regain growth in China.

articles.title: Micron beats on earnings and issues strong guidance as data center revenue jumps 11-fold
articles.summary: Micron is up over 500% in the past year as the company benefits from soaring AI demand.

articles.title: We're raising our Micron price target after an incredible quarter and robust guidance
articles.summary: Micron signaled that fiscal 2027 will be another strong year as demand for its memory products continues to exceed supply.

articles.title: Costco makes progress on a key membership metric. Here's our new price target on the stock
articles.summary: Costco's membership renewal rates moved in the right direction. But the debate isn't totally settled just yet.

articles.title: Darden Restaurants stock falls as Olive Garden reports slower growth
articles.summary: Olive Garden's same-store sales growth has slowed in recent quarters.

articles.title: Salesforce issues revenue target of over $63 billion for fiscal 2030, beating estimates
articles.summary: Salesforce issued some updated longer-term financials at its annual Dreamforce conference.

articles.title: J.B. Hunt stock plunges 13% after company warns third-quarter earnings will fall
articles.summary: Shares of J.B. Hunt plunged 13% Wednesday after the company warned of an earnings drop between 5% and 10%.

articles.title: Oracle posts 30% revenue growth fueled by AI cloud demand as debts hits $125 billion
articles.summary: Oracle's cloud infrastructure revenue jumped 121% from a year earlier, reflecting demand for AI cloud services.

articles.title: Oracle's stock edges up on earnings beat as cloud infrastructure revenue more than doubles
articles.summary: Oracle's results for the quarter came in stronger than expected, as did its revenue backlog.

articles.title: Macy's posts strong results, raises guidance as turnaround begins to take hold
articles.summary: Macy's posted strong fiscal second-quarter results on Thursday and raised its full-year guidance.

articles.title: World’s largest contract chipmaker TSMC sees August revenue surge over 53% to record high
articles.summary: TSMC reported monthly sales revenue for August on Thursday.

articles.title: We got more defensive last week as Wall Street raised the bar for AI stocks
articles.summary: We initiated positions in defensive stocks to balance our AI exposure amid higher oil prices and Treasury yields.

articles.title: Zscaler beats earnings expectations, issues upbeat guidance but stock falls
articles.summary: CEO Jay Chaudhry said he's "very bullish" on Zscaler's agentic Zero Trust offering, which is gaining early momentum

articles.title: Lululemon stock plunges 20% on disappointing earnings and outlook
articles.summary: Lululemon posted another quarter of disappointing results and a sales slowdown as the company struggles to turn its business around.

articles.title: Broadcom delivers strong earnings view as CEO touts growth with AI labs
articles.summary: Broadcom gave a disappointing revenue forecast for the current quarter but provided robust earnings guidance for fiscal 2028.

articles.title: Broadcom guides to big numbers but investors wanted more. Why we're OK to hold for now
articles.summary: We recently reduced our position size, which allows us to be more patient with this one.

articles.title: Snowflake spikes 22% on healthy results and AI coding momentum
articles.summary: Snowflake business is growing quickly, in part thanks to adoption of an artificial intelligence agent for writing code.

articles.title: We're lifting our price target on Palo Alto Networks as AI-driven cyber demand intensifies
articles.summary: The stock's muted reaction in extended trading Tuesday is not a reflection of the company's results.
